title: California's battery fleet against its peak-day demand
source: Source: EIA, Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (EIA-860M) and EIA-930. CAISO's battery capacity at year's end as a percent of the mean demand of its ten highest days, 2019-2025. Batteries do not all run at full output at once.
